sn46.10:1.1: Sattime bhikkhave bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti || nāññatra Sugatavinayā || katame satta || || Satisambojjhaṅgo || la-pe || Upekhāsambojjhaṅgo || || Ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti || nāññatra Sugatavinayāti || || Pabbatavaggo pathamo || ||
sn46.10:2.0: Tassa uddānaṃ || || Himavantaṃ Kāyaṃ Sīlaṃ || Vattam Bhikkhu ca Kuṇḍali || Kūṭañca Upavāṇañca || Uppannā apare duveti || ||
